the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: decompose into constant rank r pieces; over A^1 the base-changed groupoid still has finite locally free source and target, so the determinant trick puts P(x) = Norm_s(t(x - f)) into C[x], monic of degree r; Cayley-Hamilton makes s(P) annihilate t(f), and since the coefficients of P lie in C this says t(P(f)) = 0, whence P(f) = 0 by faithful flatness of t (source lines 4551-4582)
